module_summary: ee_libs/ holds three vendored ps2sdk EE pieces built by ps2.yaml: libhdd (APA partition create/format helpers, used only by src/dash_hdd.c), libiopreboot (SifIopRebootBuffer plus the romdrv rom1 patch, used by src/init.c:847 for the exploit IOPRP reboot) and the ps2ips socket RPC client ps2ipc.c (its ps2ipc_* functions are installed into libcglue by libps2ips' ps2ipc_ps2sdk.o, so all of them are live). igr/wle_igr.c is the small first-party OPL IGR trampoline ELF that reloads storage drivers and relaunches Launchstation; src/mmce_igr.c patches its embedded config block. The include/ headers declare the dashboard API (dash.h public, dash_internal.h shared between dash_*.c), classic config defaults (config_private.h), the font atlas layout, the Google TLS root PEMs, a CDVD compatibility macro layer and a development-only autotest button script.

findings.title: 29 dashboard/config functions declared in dash_internal.h, dash.h and config_private.h have no caller
findings.problem: Each name appears only at its prototype and definition:dashThemePresetIndex, dashThemeMarkCustom, dashThemeFolderLoad, dashThemeFolderExport, dashThemeBgId, dashThemeMarkDirty, dashGfxShutdown, dashFontShutdown, dashTextWrapScrollTimed, dashIconsShutdown, dashIconsTexture, dashStoreLoaded, dashStorePersisted, dashLibShutdown, dashLibRemove, dashArtShutdown, dashDrawAppTile, dashBgDrawStatic, dashMcPresent, dashDrawFocusFrame, dashVisibleSectionName, dashFileBrowser, dashOkLabelKey, dashAppsVisibleCount, dashAppsFocusPath, DashIsEnabled, configFormatSavePathValue, configDefaultSaveTargetPath, configSaveNetworkToPath. The linker already discards all 29 (wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv). The five *Shutdown functions are dead because DashRun never returns (dash_main.c:1396).
findings.fix: Delete the 29 definitions and their prototypes (and the orphaned comment on dash_internal.h:643). Drop the source-text asserts that mention dashFileBrowser (tests/test_files_tab_lifecycle.py:24, tests/test_r3z_browser_contract.py:87), dashMcPresent (tests/test_device_input.py:394-395) and dashStoreLoaded (tests/test_device_autostart_safe_mode.py:23). Then re-check whether static helpers used only by these (for example in dash_themes.c around 1122-1195) become unused too.
findings.benefit: ~310 source lines (279 definition lines measured by brace span + ~31 prototype lines). 5,108 bytes of .text already gc-discarded (MEASURED, gc tsv sum), so no ELF change.
findings.evidence: Python word scan over every .c/.h/.S/.yaml/.py/.md/.html file in src/Launchstation for each name: only the prototype line and the definition line, plus the test mentions listed in fix (string asserts, not calls). Each name has exactly one .text.<name> row in evidence/Launchstation/raw/link/wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv; their sizes sum to 5,108. dashThemeFolderLoad/Export are also named in docs/superpowers plans only. Definition spans from a brace-matching pass over each definition line. DS34 changes only pad.c, so it adds no caller.

findings.title: libhdd: hddGetFilesystemList, hddGetInfo, hddRemoveFilesystem, hddExpandFilesystem and the state that only they read are unused
findings.problem: Launchstation calls only hddCheckPresent, hddCheckFormatted, hddFormat and hddMakeFilesystem (src/dash_hdd.c:152,155,267,285). The other four exported functions have no caller, and hddExpandFilesystem (503-564) is a copy of the sub-partition loop in hddMakeFilesystem (380-442). hddSize and hddFree, and the dread loop in hddUpdateInfo that computes hddFree, feed only hddGetInfo. Only hddMaxPartitionSize is read by live code. The header's t_hddFilesystem/t_hddInfo types, the PFS_MT_ROBUST, FS_TYPE_EXT2/EXT2_SWAP/REISER/CFS, FS_COMMON_PREFIX, ATTR_SUB_PARTITION and FS_TYPE_EMPTY macros, and the deprecated hddPowerOff-style aliases (plus their libpwroff.h include) are used by nothing else.
findings.fix: Delete the four functions, _OMIT_SYSTEM_PARTITION, hddSize/hddFree and the partition dread loop in hddUpdateInfo, leaving it as the HDIOC_MAXSECTOR query. Delete the unused types, macros, aliases and prototypes from libhdd.h. Keep FS_GROUP_*, FS_TYPE_PFS and ATTR_MAIN_PARTITION (used by dash_hdd.c and filer.c:742,846). Optionally drop the hddUpdateInfo calls in hddCheckPresent/hddCheckFormatted/hddFormat, which do not use the result. Upstream-derived (ps2sdk ee/rpc/hdd), already a private copy per ps2.yaml:420-427.
findings.benefit: ~270 lines removed. 1,608 bytes of .text already gc-discarded (MEASURED: 784+680+72+72 in gc tsv). Trimming hddUpdateInfo saves its live dread loop code and one full APA directory scan per first probe/format/create (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep over src/Launchstation for hddCheckPresent|hddCheckFormatted|hddFormat|hddMakeFilesystem|hddGetFilesystemList|hddGetInfo|hddRemoveFilesystem|hddExpandFilesystem|t_hddFilesystem|t_hddInfo: callers only in src/dash_hdd.c for the four live ones (iop/ps2hdd_osd hddFormat is an unrelated IOP symbol). hddSize/hddFree read only at libhdd.c:257-258. Header macros: word scan found no use outside libhdd.c for the deleted ones; ATTR_MAIN_PARTITION and FS_TYPE_PFS are used in filer.c. gc tsv rows 3-6 list the four functions as discarded.

findings.title: libhdd.c: dead DEBUG printf blocks and PFS_FRAGMENT branch inside live hddMakeFilesystem
findings.problem: DEBUG is only a commented-out #define (line 44) and the hdd_ee target sets no defines (ps2.yaml:423-427), so the 13 #ifdef DEBUG blocks in hddMakeFilesystem never compile. Without them, the retVal>=0 and else branches at 426-437 are empty. PFS_FRAGMENT is the constant 0 (line 35), so the three-element pfsFormatArg branch (37-39) and PFS_FRAGMENT_OPT are dead.
findings.fix: Delete the #ifdef DEBUG blocks, the commented DEBUG define, the empty else-if/else branches, and the PFS_FRAGMENT/PFS_FRAGMENT_OPT #if, keeping the one-element pfsFormatArg.
findings.benefit: ~50 lines removed from a live function; no ELF change because the blocks are already preprocessed out (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read libhdd.c in full. ps2.yaml:423-427 shows the hdd_ee target with sources, include_dirs and headers only, no defines. The brief lists DEBUG only as a src/main.c conditional, not a build define.

findings.title: LIBCDVD_LEGACY is never defined: cdvd_macro.h legacy branch, include/snippets/readCD.h and two LCDVD no-op macros are dead
findings.problem: No build file or source defines LIBCDVD_LEGACY. ps2.yaml:617 defines LIBCDVD_LATEST instead, and nothing tests that. So the CDVD_* branch of cdvd_macro.h, the cdvd_rpc.h branch in launchelf.h and the 51-line legacy readCD() in include/snippets/readCD.h (included only under the #else at filer.c:656-658) never compile. In the live branch LCDVD_FLUSHCACHE() and LCDVD_INIT() expand to nothing, so the calls at filer.c:962, init.c:1334, init.c:1458 and main_actions.c:812 are no-ops. The two remaining macros only rename sceCdStop/sceCdDiskReady.
findings.fix: Delete include/cdvd_macro.h and include/snippets/readCD.h. Call sceCdStop()/sceCdDiskReady(0) directly at the four LCDVD_STOP/LCDVD_DISKREADY sites and delete the LCDVD_FLUSHCACHE/LCDVD_INIT lines. Drop the LIBCDVD_LEGACY #ifdef/#else lines in launchelf.h and filer.c, and the unused LIBCDVD_LATEST define. Update the stub macros in tests/test_launch_driver_messages.py:213-214.
findings.benefit: ~80 lines removed (16 + 51 + ~13 conditional/no-op lines); no ELF change (INFERRED: the dead branches are preprocessed out).
findings.evidence: Grep LCDVD_|cdvd_macro.h|LIBCDVD_LEGACY over src/Launchstation: definitions in cdvd_macro.h, tests at launchelf.h:66, snippets/readCD.h:1, filer.c:604; uses at filer.c:962-963, init.c:1334,1404,1458-1459, main_actions.c:812-813; test stubs in tests/test_launch_driver_messages.py:213-214. Grep LIBCDVD_LATEST: only ps2.yaml:617. readCD.h is included only at filer.c:657 inside the #else.

findings.title: SifIopRebootBufferEncrypted is unused, and the always-on F_* section guards and extinfo types in the vendored iopreboot copy are dead
findings.problem: The only caller of the library is SifIopRebootBuffer at src/init.c:847. SifIopRebootBufferEncrypted (124-156) and SifLoadModuleEncryptedSpecial (120-121) have no caller and are gc-discarded (280 bytes). ps2.yaml:414-417 always defines all three F_* macros for this single translation unit, so the #ifdef guards are always true. extinfo_t and enum EXTINFO_TYPE (50-62) are referenced only in comments.
findings.fix: Delete SifIopRebootBufferEncrypted, the encrypted load macro, extinfo_t/EXTINFO_TYPE, the three #ifdef F_* / #endif pairs and the defines block in ps2.yaml, and update the header comment at lines 4-7. Vendored from ps2sdk; this only trims the private copy.
findings.benefit: ~55 lines removed (source and ps2.yaml); 280 bytes .text already gc-discarded (MEASURED, gc tsv), so no ELF change.
findings.evidence: Grep SifIopRebootBuffer|extinfo_t|EXTINFO_TYPE over src/Launchstation: SifIopRebootBufferEncrypted only at its definition; SifIopRebootBuffer called at src/init.c:847; EXTINFO_TYPE only in comments at 209/211. ps2.yaml:411-418 shows the target with the three defines. gc tsv row 7: .text.SifIopRebootBufferEncrypted 280. The scripted 'no build file defines F_*' lead was wrong: ps2.yaml defines them.

findings.title: DASH_AUTOTEST development hook (include/dash_autotest.h and its users) is never built and its script is stale
findings.problem: No build defines DASH_AUTOTEST (not in ps2.yaml or configure_ds34.py). The header is included only under that macro at pad.c:289, and dash_main.c:1304-1323 injects a fake demo library under the same macro. The script targets screens that no longer exist as tabs: an APPS grid and a DEVICES tab, while dash_main.c:1325-1330 now folds Apps into Home and Devices into Files.
findings.fix: Delete include/dash_autotest.h, the two #ifdef DASH_AUTOTEST blocks in pad.c, the demo-library block in dash_main.c and the paragraph in docs/dashboard.md (and the matching docs-site developers text).
findings.benefit: ~85 source lines removed; no ELF change (INFERRED: never compiled).
findings.evidence: Grep dash_autotest|DASH_AUTOTEST over src/Launchstation: dash_autotest.h, pad.c:284,289,300-302,313, dash_main.c:1304-1305, docs/dashboard.md:601-602, docs-site/content/developers.html:24; no define in any yaml or script. Read pad.c:280-330 and dash_main.c:1300-1338.

findings.title: wle_igr.c: the HDD driver stack is reloaded on every one of up to 24 path-resolution retries
findings.problem: resolve_app_path calls hdd_target_path on each attempt (151-154, WLE_IGR_TRIES = 24, 250 ms apart). Each call runs SifExecModuleBuffer again for ps2dev9, bdm, bdmfs_fatfs, ata_bd, ps2hdd and ps2fs (122-134), then calls fileXioInit (136). If the first mount fails because the drive is still spinning up, every retry loads six more module copies instead of retrying only the mount. Unlike the other device families, main() (228-255) has no hdd branch that loads the drivers once.
findings.fix: Load the HDD modules once in main(): add hdd0/hdd1 to the ata branch and start ps2hdd/ps2fs with their arguments there. Reduce hdd_target_path to the path split and the pfs0: mount. This also removes the second copy of the ata_bd/bdm load sequence.
findings.benefit: Saves up to 23 x 6 redundant IOP module loads and the IOP memory and time they take on the HDD IGR path (INFERRED). About 5 fewer lines.
findings.evidence: Read wle_igr.c in full. HDD boot paths reach this helper: src/mmce_igr.c:463-470 (is_bdm_relaunch_path includes hdd) and 542-556 install it. INFERRED part: what a second load of ps2dev9/ps2hdd returns (likely NO_RESIDENT_END, which start_module accepts). Either way the loads repeat on every retry.

findings.title: config_private.h: the CUSTOM_COLORS #ifdef selects two identical colour sets
findings.problem: Both branches define DEF_COLOR1..DEF_COLOR8 with exactly the same GS_SETREG_RGBA values (lines 11-18 and 20-27). CUSTOM_COLORS is tested nowhere else in the repo, so the define in ps2.yaml:630 has no effect.
findings.fix: Keep one set of DEF_COLOR lines, delete the #ifdef/#else/#endif and the other copy, and remove CUSTOM_COLORS from ps2.yaml:630 and the comment on line 9.
findings.evidence: Grep CUSTOM_COLORS over src/Launchstation: ps2.yaml:9 (comment), ps2.yaml:630 (define), config_private.h:10,28 only. Compared lines 11-18 against 20-27: same values.

findings.title: dash_internal.h/dash.h/draw_private.h: unused macros and enum, duplicate prototypes, stale comments
findings.problem: DASH_SAFE_T and DASH_SAFE_B are never used. DASH_SELECT_EXTRA_W is used only by a test that copies it (tests/test_editor_keyboard.py:49), not by source. enum DashAnim (556-561) and DASH_FX_COUNT are never referenced. dashWorkerIoBusy is prototyped in both dash.h:35 and dash_internal.h:990 (dash_internal.h includes dash.h), and gsScreenGeneration is declared in both draw_private.h:7 and dash_internal.h:1143. The comment at dash_internal.h:285 belongs to dashThemeSetFocusApp (300), not to the enum below it. dash.h:11-13 says DashRun returns to the classic menu, but DashRun never returns (dash_main.c:1396).
findings.fix: Delete the unused macros, enum DashAnim and DASH_FX_COUNT (keeping the test in step), the second dashWorkerIoBusy prototype and one gsScreenGeneration extern. Move or delete the stray comment and correct the DashRun comment.
findings.evidence: Python word scan over src/Launchstation (c/h/S/yaml/py/md/html): DASH_SAFE_T, DASH_SAFE_B, DashAnim, DASH_ANIM_COUNT, DASH_FX_COUNT appear only in dash_internal.h (DASH_ANIM_OFF also in a docs/superpowers plan); DASH_SELECT_EXTRA_W at dash_internal.h:40 and tests/test_editor_keyboard.py:49 only. dashWorkerIoBusy at dash.h:35 and dash_internal.h:990 plus callers; gsScreenGeneration externs at draw_private.h:7 and dash_internal.h:1143. dash_main.c:1347-1348 is the only return in DashRun (re-entry guard).
